[ce] Eval X-Y-Z(a,t1,t2).vi

Owning Palette: Formula Evaluation

Describes a surface in 3D with two variables running over two different intervals. In addition, the VI allows specifying additional parameters and evaluating them in formulas.

Click the parameters for more information

 

# points. Describes the number of grid points for both variables.
Start. Start points
t1. Initial value of first variable
t2. Initial value of second variable
End. End points
t1. Final value of first variable
t2. Final value of second variable
formulas info.
formula 1. A string describing first component of the surface under investigation.
formula 2. A string describing second component of the surface under investigation.
formula 3. A string describing third component of the surface under investigation.
variable 1. Name of first variable used in formulas
variable 2. Name of second variable used in formulas
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
parameters. Array of clusters describing optional parameters that may be used in formula. Cluster consist of parameter name and value.
name parameter name
value parameter value
X(t1,t2). A 1D array of the x values at the grid points.
Y(t1,t2). A 1D array of the y values at the grid points.
Z(t1,t2). A 1D array of the z values at the grid points.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
ticks time of the VI execution (milliseconds)
